name: titanapt
description: TitanApt - aptitude learning and IT placement preparation platform

scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/with-db.mjs npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: node scripts/with-db.mjs npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.build: npm run build -w @titanapt/shared && npm run build -w @titanapt/api && npm run build -w @titanapt/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @titanapt/shared && npm run typecheck -w @titanapt/api && npm run typecheck -w @titanapt/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @titanapt/api && npm run test -w @titanapt/web
